## How to choose the right lawyer

Before engaging a firm, I would ask these five questions\:

1. **Who will actually handle my case?** Ask about the individual solicitor's relevant experience and whether they are an Accredited Family Law Specialist.
2. **What will it cost?** Request the initial consultation fee, hourly rates, likely total cost and any staged or fixed-fee options.
3. **Can the dispute be settled without court?** Ask how the firm approaches negotiation, mediation and court proceedings.
4. **How will I receive updates?** Establish who your main contact will be and how quickly the firm typically responds.
5. **Have they handled cases like mine?** A straightforward divorce, a contested parenting matter and a complex property settlement require different strengths.

You can independently verify solicitors using the [Queensland Law Society's Find a Solicitor directory](https://www.qls.com.au/For-the-community/Find-a-solicitor)\.

## How to choose the right lawyer

Before engaging a firm, I would ask these five questions\:

1. **Who will actually handle my case?** Ask about the individual solicitor's relevant experience and whether they are an Accredited Family Law Specialist.
2. **What will it cost?** Request the initial consultation fee, hourly rates, likely total cost and any staged or fixed-fee options.
3. **Can the dispute be settled without court?** Ask how the firm approaches negotiation, mediation and court proceedings.
4. **How will I receive updates?** Establish who your main contact will be and how quickly the firm typically responds.
5. **Have they handled cases like mine?** A straightforward divorce, a contested parenting matter and a complex property settlement require different strengths.

You can independently verify solicitors using the [Queensland Law Society's Find a Solicitor directory](https://www.qls.com.au/For-the-community/Find-a-solicitor)\.
